notes:
Inbound from content/marketing platform channel — high-volume use. Account summary: QuickFolio builds multi-tenant content engines for small e-commerce and agency customers. They push 100s of articles/week per tenant during batches. Primary ask = cheap, reliable text generation via self-serve Hosted API.

Conversation highlights (discovery call 2024-11-12):
- 'We need predictable unit economics — token cost is the gating factor for our pricing.' — CTO (Sam Rivers).
- Workload: nightly bulk generation jobs + ad-hoc landing page copy updates via UI. Often run as batched jobs (bulk create 500 articles), plus low-latency edge calls for personalization (10-50 qps).
- Throughput/latency targets: bulk throughput important for cost; edge calls target <=200ms p95.
- Typical prompt lengths: 200-800 tokens (template + product data). Output avg 150-300 tokens.
- Model preference: open/affordable models preferred (Llama-family/other quantized variants) but willing to start on Redwood-hosted curated models.
- Key feature asks: automatic batching recommendations, prefix/KV caching for repeated templates, token-cost dashboard, per-route cost breakdowns. Expressed interest in Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Security: SOC2 baseline required for procurement later; initial usage on public AWS (us-east-1). SSO will be required for enterprise rollout but not needed for initial trial.

POC idea discussed: 1) Run a 1-week bulk generation POC with sample job of 2k articles using batching + caching config; 2) measure token cost delta vs current provider; 3) show token-efficiency dashboard and cost breakdown. POC success metric = >=20% cost reduction per article or equivalent quality at similar cost.

Quotes / shorthand in notes:
- 'If you can shave 20% off cost we can move billing to you' (Sam).
- 'Show me examples of prefix caching reducing tokens on repeated templates' (Head of Ops).

- Need clear pricing examples for bulk jobs (per-token + batch discounts).
- Want batching code samples / SDK snippet for node/python in repo.
